implementation_details: Implemented comprehensive MCP server health management system to resolve critical issue of 40+ zombie processes causing Claude Desktop MCP tool failures. Created automated scripts for health checking, launching, stopping, and integrated initialization of MCP servers. The system now provides visibility and control over 6 critical MCP servers required for KarmaCash development.
files_modified: /scripts/check-mcp-health.sh - Health check script with stale process cleanup
/scripts/stop-mcp-servers.sh - Clean shutdown script for all servers
challenges_encountered: 1. Initial Protocol Essentials file access failed due to incorrect naming convention (needed .optimized.json format). 2. Launch script had issues with nohup/background processes not starting properly. 3. Firebase MCP server appears to be down preventing Firestore updates during implementation.
testing_completed: Tested health check script which successfully identified and killed 40+ stale processes. Verified script permissions and execution. Confirmed cleanup of zombie processes from May 23rd. Launch script execution tested but servers failed to start in background mode.
next_steps: 1. Investigate alternative launch methods (screen/tmux) for better background process handling. 2. Test manual server launches to verify commands are correct. 3. Update CG_Access_Module_Init with new Step 0 for MCP health check. 4. Consider systemd services for production deployment.
